senses.zh: （想法、决定等）合理的，基于理性的
senses.en: rational thoughts, decisions, etc. are based on reasons rather than emotions
examples: Parents need to be fully informed before they can make a [[rational]] decision.

senses.en: relating to the natural processes performed by living things
examples: Breathing and sleeping are examples of [[biological]] rhythms in humans.

senses.en: relating to genes or genetics
examples: I'm giving a seminar on the latest developments in [[genetic]] research next week.

senses.en: an extremely small living thing which can only be seen if you use a microscope. Some microbes can cause diseases.
examples: Was it not the duty of the doctor to kill the [[microbes]]?

senses.en: very silly or unreasonable
examples: It's [[ridiculous]] that we have to wait two weeks for the operation.

senses.en: in a way that is based on feelings rather than facts or proof
examples: She had sensed, [[intuitively]], that Larry was interested in her.

senses.en: in a way that shows you are happy or pleased to do sth. or that you do not object to doing sth.
examples: Sixty percent of voters said they would [[willingly]] pay higher taxes for better health care.

senses.en: move your body quickly away from sb. / sth. because you find them or it frightening or unpleasant
examples: Howard [[recoiled]] a little at the sharpness in my voice.

senses.en: a feeling of great shock, fear, or disgust
examples: The thought of being left alone filled her with [[horror]].

senses.en: a feeling that sb. / sth. is unpleasant or morally offensive
examples: She was trying her best not to show her [[distaste]].

senses.zh: （相似物体之间的）差异；（数量或形式的）变化，变动
senses.en: a difference between similar things, or a change from the usual amount or form of sth.
examples: There might be striking [[variations]] within a species.

senses.en: a nerve ending which receives information about changes in light, heat, etc. and causes the body to react in particular ways
examples: In the year 2000, taste [[receptors]] that detect this chemical were discovered on the tongue.

senses.en: more than enough in quantity
examples: I provided a [[plentiful]] supply of games to keep the children occupied.

senses.en: (deoxyribonucleic acid)

senses.zh: 令人恶心的；使人极其反感的；令人厌恶的
senses.en: extremely unpleasant and making you feel sick
examples: The kitchen was in a [[disgusting]] state when she left.

senses.en: fair, practical, and sensible
examples: Be [[reasonable]] — you can't expect her to do all the work on her own!

senses.zh: 减轻；缓解（疼痛或不快的感觉）
senses.en: reduce sb.'s pain or unpleasant feelings
examples: This kind of drug can help to [[relieve]] the pain, but it should be used carefully.

senses.en: feeling happy because you are no longer worried about sth.
examples: She looked immensely [[relieved]] when she heard the news.

senses.zh: （素质或能力）天生的，与生俱来的
senses.en: an innate quality or ability is sth. you are born with
examples: Children seem to have an [[innate]] ability to learn language.

senses.en: sexually attractive
examples: He was with the young woman whom his classmates thought most [[desirable]].
The ability to speak a foreign language is highly [[desirable]].

senses.zh: 理想的；值得拥有的；值得做的
senses.en: (fml.) sth. that is desirable is worth having or doing
examples: He was with the young woman whom his classmates thought most [[desirable]].
The ability to speak a foreign language is highly [[desirable]].

senses.en: (infml.) a husband, wife, or other sexual partner
examples: Many matchmaking sites compile lists of potential [[mates]] using basic information.
Some of my office [[mates]] are planning to throw a party for me.

senses.en: sb. you work with, do an activity with, or share sth. with
examples: Many matchmaking sites compile lists of potential [[mates]] using basic information.
Some of my office [[mates]] are planning to throw a party for me.

senses.zh: （尤指女子或其部分身体）好看的，匀称的
senses.en: (esp. of a woman or part of her body) having an attractive or well-proportioned shape
examples: She was about my age and had long, [[shapely]] legs and a beautiful smile.

senses.en: shining and flashing with light
examples: This is a region of [[sparkling]] lakes, rushing streams, and dense forests.

senses.zh: 好看的；好听的；有吸引力的
senses.en: very pleasing in appearance or sound
examples: I thought he was very [[attractive]] and obviously very intelligent.

senses.en: relating to the way in which plants and animals develop and change gradually over a long period of time
examples: Some scholars are keen to see [[evolutionary]] theory challenged in university lecture halls.

senses.en: if an animal or plant reproduces, or reproduces itself, it produces young plants or animals
examples: Many single cell organisms [[reproduce]] by splitting in two.

senses.en: relating to being a parent and esp. to being responsible for a child's safety and development
examples: [[Parental]] consent is required before the operation can take place.

senses.zh: （某人的）子女，子孙，后代（常为幽默用法）
senses.en: (pl. offspring) sb.'s child or children — often used humorously
examples: Tom's sister came over on Saturday with all her [[offspring]].

senses.en: a lack of interest
examples: The exception to Tom’s [[disinterest]] in social issues was education.

senses.zh: 令人灰心的；令人气馁的
senses.en: making you lose hope and determination
examples: It is [[disheartening]] to see what little progress has been made.

senses.en: (not before noun) seeming certain to happen at some time in the future
examples: He feels that he is [[destined]] to become a musician, just like his father.

senses.zh: 成为某事物的奴隶，完全受某事物控制（含贬义）
senses.en: (be a ~ of / to sth.) be so strongly influenced by sth. that you cannot make your own decisions — used to show disapproval
examples: How can she not see that she has become a [[slave]] of fashion?
By the time I was 10, I had become her [[slave]], doing all the housework.

senses.en: sb. who is owned by another person and works for them for no money
examples: How can she not see that she has become a [[slave]] of fashion?
By the time I was 10, I had become her [[slave]], doing all the housework.

senses.zh: 壮丽的；宏伟的；值得赞扬的
senses.en: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise
examples: I think he deserves congratulations for a [[magnificent]] job well done.

senses.en: deal with a problem or improve a bad situation
examples: To [[remedy]] the situation, the water must be chemically treated.
There is no simple [[remedy]] for unemployment.

senses.zh: （问题的）解决方式；（糟糕状况的）补救方法
senses.en: a way of dealing with a problem or making a bad situation better
examples: To [[remedy]] the situation, the water must be chemically treated.
There is no simple [[remedy]] for unemployment.

senses.en: a strong feeling of sympathy for sb. who is suffering, and a desire to help them
examples: He was filled with overwhelming love and [[compassion]] for his wife.

senses.en: if sth. makes sense, there seems to be a good reason or explanation for it
examples: Why did she do a thing like that? It doesn't seem to [[make sense]].

senses.en: try to find out about sth. unknown or secret
examples: When you [[dig into]] the data a bit though, things look gloomier.

senses.zh: 突然想出（主意）；无意中发现（某事）
senses.en: have an idea or discover sth. suddenly or unexpectedly
examples: When we first [[hit upon]] the idea, everyone told us it would never work.

senses.en: start to love sb. very much
examples: The minute we met I knew this was the girl I wanted to give my heart to.

senses.en: concerning sb. / sth.
examples: Frank was very uncertain [[as to]] whether it was the right job for him.

senses.en: very unhappy because sb. has sth. that you want
examples: Chad is heading off to Spain for the week, and I'm [[green with envy]].

senses.zh: （为达到某个结果而）开始做某事，着手进行
senses.en: start doing sth. or making plans to do sth. in order to achieve a particular result
examples: He has achieved what he [[set out to do]] three years ago.

senses.zh: 负责处理某事；负责解决某事
senses.en: (spoken) if sb. says they are on the case, they know about a problem and are going to try to solve it
examples: "We need to book a flight before it's too late." "Don't worry, I'm [[on the case]]."

senses.en: used to say sth. is impossible for sb. to control
examples: There was nothing we could do about it — the situation was beyond our control.

senses.en: support sb. / sth.
examples: The president is [[lending support]] to the governor's re-election campaign.

senses.zh: 因认为某人的言行针对自己而不快
senses.en: get upset by the things other people say or do, because you think that their remarks or behaviors are directed at you in particular
examples: Don't [[take it personally]]; she is rude to everyone.
